checks.misses: It finds gaps in the paths the model read and cannot show that every input is validated.

checks.covers: Skipping or reordering steps of a flow and replaying a completed flow, read by a model.
checks.misses: It finds violations in the paths the model read and cannot show every flow enforces its order.

entries.why: The block names step skipping and state machine violations, which is the weakness of flows that accept steps out of order.

checks.covers: Partial failure in a multi-step operation and whether earlier steps are rolled back, read by a model.
checks.misses: Sampled reading; it does not confirm that a database transaction wraps the whole operation.

entries.why: The block asks what happens when a later step fails after an earlier one succeeded, which is what an all-or-nothing operation prevents.

checks.covers: Concurrent operations that break limited resources through check-then-act races, read by a model.
checks.misses: Sampled reading; it does not prove a lock exists on every scarce resource.

entries.why: The block asks for race conditions on non-atomic check-then-act operations, which is how limited resources get double-booked.
